author: Ari Koslow
title: Jock Landale to return to Hawks on one-year deal
desc: Jock Landale intends to sign a one-year, $14 million deal to return to the Atlanta Hawks.
impact: Landale was traded to Atlanta last season where he averaged 10.6 points and 5.7 rebounds. He'll figure to remain in a similar role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bronny James contract becomes fully guaranteed
desc: Bronny James' contract with the Los Angeles Lakers became fully guaranteed for $2.3 million on Monday.
impact: Bronny will no longer be playing with LeBron, who announced Tuesday that he is leaving the team. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Sasser linked to Mavericks in trade talks
desc: The Mavericks have emerged a leading suitor to acquire Detroit's Marcus Sasser in a trade.
impact: This will be a situation to continue to monitor. Dallas continues to look to build up its depth in the back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Simone Fontecchio signs one-year deal with Heat
desc: Simone Fontecchio intends to sign a one-year deal to return to the Miami Heat.
impact: Fontecchio averaged 8.5 points on 37.5 percent three-point shooting last season. He'll remain in a reserve role.

author: Garrett Ball
title: LeBron James informs Lakers he will play elsewhere in 2026-27 season
desc: LeBron James has informed the Los Angeles Lakers that he intends to play elsewhere this upcoming 2026-27 season and to move on without him.
impact: This is a big leap forward for the LeBron to the Warriors rumors, which is admittedly still up in the air. However, it does provide closure to the LeBron-Lakers era, as well as the LeBron-Luka duo. It's now a waiting game as to see who will get James next and what their playoff and title aspirations might be.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Robert Williams III signing 3-year, $44 million deal with Blazers
desc: Robert Williams III has agreed to a 3-year, $44 million deal with the Portland Trailblazers.
impact: Time Lord will return to a Blazers team that recently added Ja Morant and should get Damian Lillard back this upcoming season. Portland isn't quite among the top of the Western Conference, but with their youth, potential stars, and veteran playmakers, they appear to be on an upward trajectory.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tobias Harris unlikely to return to Pistons
desc: Tobias Harris is reportedly unlikely to return to Detroit in free agency.
impact: Harris should draw plenty of interest from other teams in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joshua Jefferson to miss start of Summer League
desc: Joshua Jefferson will miss the start of the Summer League in Sacramento.
impact: Jefferson cannot play for the Nets' Summer League team until the Julius Randle trade is finalized. He is expected to be good to go for the second part in Las Vegas.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Bilodeau good to go for Summer League
desc: Tyler Bilodeau is expected to be available for both Summer League stops.
impact: Bilodeau was a second-round pick of the Nets this year. He will figure to compete for a depth role in their back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mikel Brown Jr. good to go for Summer League
desc: Mikel Brown Jr. is expected to be available for both Summer League stops.
impact: Brown was the No. 6 overall pick by Brooklyn this year. He should step into an immediate major role in the Nets back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Peyton Watson linked to Clippers
desc: Peyton Watson reportedly continues to be described as a "likely target" for the Clippers.
impact: Watson is a restricted free agent this offseason. He'll figure to draw interest from other teams.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Kessler to meet with three teams Tuesday
desc: Walker Kessler is scheduled to meet with three teams on Tuesday.
impact: The Lakers are rumored to be one of the three teams. Kessler is a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Russell Westbrook III linked to Wizards
desc: The Wizards reportedly have interest in Russell Westbrook III.
impact: Westbrook previously played one year in Washington back in the 2020-21 season. He would figure to step into a reserve role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Kuminga to draw interest from Bulls, Cavs
desc: The Bulls and Cavaliers are expected to be among the teams to express interest in Jonathan Kuminga in free agency.
impact: Kuminga was also previously linked to the Kings. He should draw plenty of interest after having his team option declined by the Hawks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jrue Holiday expected to remain in Portland
desc: The Trail Blazers are not expected to look to trade Jrue Holiday.
impact: After trading for Ja Morant on Monday, it would make sense that Portland could look to move another guard. It appears the veteran will remain with the team, at least for now.
